skill.name: iso-13485-certification
skill.description: Comprehensive toolkit for preparing ISO 13485 certification documentation for medical device Quality Management Systems. Use when users need help with ISO 13485 QMS documentation, including (1) conducting gap analysis of existing documentation, (2) creating Quality Manuals, (3) developing required procedures and work instructions, (4) preparing Medical Device Files, (5) understanding ISO 13485 requirements, or (6) identifying missing documentation for medical device certification. Also use when users mention medical device regulations, QMS certification, FDA QMSR, EU MDR, or need help with quality system documentation.
skill.summary: Prepare ISO 13485 QMS documentation, templates, and gap analysis for medical device certification.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

content.value_statement: Medical device teams must create complete QMS documentation before certification audits. This skill provides templates, checklists, and gap analysis guidance for ISO 13485 readiness.
actual_capabilities: Runs a local gap analyzer against user-provided document folders.
Provides Quality Manual, CAPA, and document control templates.
Identifies missing mandatory procedures and key QMS documents.
Helps customize procedures for medical device quality systems.
Supports audit readiness planning with checklists and priorities.
limitations: It does not provide legal or regulatory certification advice.
It cannot replace review by a qualified quality or regulatory expert.
The gap analyzer reads text and markdown content more deeply than office or PDF files.
Templates require organization-specific process details before use.

use_cases.title: Start a New QMS
use_cases.description: Build the first set of ISO 13485 documents using a phased documentation roadmap.

use_cases.title: Check Existing Documentation
use_cases.description: Compare current procedures and manuals against ISO 13485 requirements before an audit.

use_cases.title: Update Regulatory Alignment
use_cases.description: Revise QMS documents for FDA QMSR, EU MDR, and ISO 13485 terminology consistency.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the ISO 13485 documentation requirements for a small medical device company. Focus on the first documents we should create.

prompt_templates.title: Review Current Documents
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate gap analysis using an existing folder.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the QMS documents in my provided folder and summarize which ISO 13485 procedures and key documents appear missing.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Procedure
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate document creation from a template.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me draft a CAPA procedure for our organization. Ask for the missing company-specific details before producing the procedure.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Audit Readiness Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning across QMS documents and records.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ISO 13485 certification audit readiness plan using our gap report, document status, known exclusions, and target audit date.

output_examples.input: We have a quality manual and CAPA procedure. What should we check next?
output_examples.output: The skill would list likely missing core procedures, highlight document control and records control, and recommend a clause-based gap review.

output_examples.input: Create a CAPA procedure for a Class II device manufacturer.
output_examples.output: The skill would produce a structured procedure with purpose, scope, roles, CAPA initiation, investigation, action planning, verification, records, and approvals.

output_examples.input: Help us prepare for an ISO 13485 audit in three months.
output_examples.output: The skill would create a readiness plan covering document approval, training records, internal audit evidence, management review, CAPA status, and mock audit actions.

best_practices: Provide current procedures, product scope, device classes, and applicable regions before requesting document drafts.
Review every generated procedure with quality leadership before release or training.
Use the templates as controlled drafts and replace all placeholders with real process details.
anti_patterns: Do not copy template text into the QMS without matching actual company practices.
Do not treat the gap analyzer as proof of certification readiness.
Do not omit exclusion justifications from the Quality Manual.

faq.question: Can this skill certify my company to ISO 13485?
faq.answer: No. It helps prepare documentation, but certification requires an accredited audit and implemented QMS processes.

faq.question: Does it include document templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes templates for a Quality Manual, CAPA procedure, and document control procedure.

faq.question: Can it analyze my existing QMS documents?
faq.answer: Yes. The included script can scan a local document folder and identify likely documentation gaps.

faq.question: Does it support FDA QMSR alignment?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance discusses QMSR harmonization and Medical Device File updates.

faq.question: Will it read PDF and office documents fully?
faq.answer: Not fully. The gap analyzer records some file types by filename, while text and markdown files get content scanning.

faq.question: Should a regulatory expert review the outputs?
faq.answer: Yes. A qualified quality or regulatory professional should approve documents before controlled release.
